content: प्रतिग्रहः .²1 Receiving, accepting. .²2 Receiving or accepting a donation; अयाचितोपपन्ने तु नास्ति दोषः प्रतिग्रहे .²3 The right of receiving or accepting a donation. .²4 The right of receiving gifts (which is a peculiar prerogative of Brāhmaṇas); अध्यापनमध्ययनं यजनं याजनं तथा . दानं प्रतिग्रहं चैव ब्राह्मणानामकल्पयत् .. <ls>Ms. 1. 88</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 86</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 118</ls>. .²5 A gift, present, donation; राज्ञः प्रतिग्रहोऽयम् <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; <ls>Śi. 14. 35</ls>. .²6 A receiver (of a gift). .²7 Kind or friendly reception; प्रतिग्रहाय पाण्डूनां प्रेषयामास कौरवान् <ls>Mb. 1. 207. 12</ls>. .²8 Favour, grace. .²9 Marrying; तत्प्रतिग्रहलाभाय जित्वा भूपान् स्वयंवरे <ls>Bm. 1. 456</ls>. .²10 Listening to. .²11 The rear of an army. .²12 A spitting-pot. .²13 The sun near the moonʼs node. .²14 a chamber-vessel (for sick persons). .²15 a grasper, seizer; केशप्रतिग्रहः = barber.
